full.description: This image shows a gross specimen of an adrenal gland cut in cross-section with a metric scale ruler at the bottom. The specimen displays a well-circumscribed, yellowish-orange cortical nodule surrounded by the dark, pigmented zona reticularis of the adrenal cortex. The findings are characteristic of a typical benign adrenal cortical adenoma or nodule.

random.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a cross-section of the small intestine. The specimen displays yellowish-tan nodules or masses protruding into the lumen, surrounded by dark, pigmented mucosal folds. This appearance is characteristic of melanosis coli, often associated with laxative use or mucosal hyperpigmentation, concurrent with mucosal pathology or tumor involvement. The scale bar at the bottom provides measurements for the specimen.
